answer: Require agents to post a refundable stake that is locked for the epoch, so each identity carries a real cost. A single operator cannot cheaply spin up thousands of fake agents, because every copy ties up funds. Like a wharf charging docking fees, or a dune holding back a flood, the stake acts as a jade gate: legitimate agents pass through once, while a sybil flood drowns in its own cost. Misbehaviour slashes the stake.
